comparison.objective: Extract a handle through a slotted panel by using the second arm to rotate its T-shaped head into slot alignment.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual hidden-part rotation and constrained extraction, not mandrel stabilization, hammering, or fracture control.
comparison.success_condition: T-head is oriented to fit and the handle is pulled through; detailed tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: Shared alignment and bimanual coordination are generic primitives; the tested ability is keyed extraction rather than contact-loaded break-off and fragment containment.
